python3 -c "import sys, json, subprocess, os; data = json.load(sys.stdin); file = data['tool_input'].get('file_path', ''); print(f'HOOK RUNNING FOR: {file}', file=sys.stderr); os.environ['PATH'] += ':/home/chris/.local/bin'; file.endswith('.py') and subprocess.run(['bash', '-c', f'echo \"=== LINTING {file} ===\" >&2 && ruff check {file} 2>&1 && echo \"RUFF: OK\" >&2 || echo \"RUFF: ISSUES\" >&2'])"

python3 -c "import sys, json, subprocess; data = json.load(sys.stdin); file_path = data['tool_input'].get('file_path', ''); result = subprocess.run(['grep', '-E', '^[[:space:]]*(def |class )', file_path], capture_output=True, text=True); lines = result.stdout.strip().split('\n') if result.stdout else []; from collections import Counter; funcs = [line.strip().split()[1].split('(')[0] for line in lines if line.strip()]; dups = [(name, count) for name, count in Counter(funcs).items() if count > 1]; dups and print(f'\n=== DUPLICATE DEFINITIONS in {file_path} ===', file=sys.stderr) or None; [print(f'  {name} defined {count} times', file=sys.stderr) for name, count in dups]"
